summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Jiří Šejba, a Czechoslovak-born retired professional ice hockey forward. It states his birth date and place, that he played one National Hockey League season with the Buffalo Sabres, and that he is currently the coach of GKS Tychy.
one_line: Jiří Šejba is a retired Czechoslovak-born hockey forward who played one NHL season with the Buffalo Sabres and now coaches GKS Tychy.
key_facts: Jiří Šejba was born on July 22, 1962, in Pardubice, Czechoslovakia.
Jiří Šejba is a retired professional hockey forward.
Jiří Šejba played 1 season in the National Hockey League.
Jiří Šejba played in the National Hockey League for the Buffalo Sabres.
Jiří Šejba is the current coach of GKS Tychy.
